| description = Mooto spawns near the goblin camps outside of Runnyeye Citadel ( specifically on the left side of the campfire at the goblin camp, right outside Runnyeye) . [[A goblin shaman]], [[a goblin warrior]], and [[a goblin alchemist]] are placeholders. 

He periodically runs from goblin camp to goblin camp, buffing and assisting other goblins as he goes.

Occasionally he will drop a totem with +5hp, possibly another minor item.

For evil races dedicated to banking in Rivervale, Mooto faction farming is a great AFK-ish camp. If you sit at -444, 1085 (a tree near the ent to Runnyeye), Mooto or his PH will aggro you every 7~ minutes. He spawns at the goblin camp to the left of Runnyeye, and runs north, directly in your path.
